info.title: Ruri Scrape Service API
info.description: Authenticated text-metadata cache: language/field selection, bounded persistence, daily successful acquisitions, durable jobs, import/export. No binary-image service or manual metadata edits. See scrape-service.md.

get.description: Admin session or admin API key only. Bounded retained diagnostics, newest first. Successful log and health reads do not log themselves; normal accesses require diagnostics_enabled. attention filters warn/error before cursor pagination.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Exact level, or attention for warn and error together. Omit for all retained records.

schema.description: Decimal revision string. Preserve precision; do not convert through a floating-point number.

translations.description: Distinct BCP 47 locales, excluding und and all original metadata text locales. Does not change original_locale.

MetadataPackage.description: One portable product snapshot with optional local translations and embedded images. Entire JSON at most 64 MiB; normalized metadata at most 8 MiB.

original_locale.description: BCP 47 language tag; canonicalized by the server. Use und for unknown.

items.description: BCP 47 language tag; canonicalized by the server. Use und for unknown.

PackageMetadata.description: Portable provider descriptions without local work/node identity. Original texts are preserved; local translations are separate package entries.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag; canonicalized by the server. Use und for unknown.

description_parts.description: Ordered structured description, <=256 KiB total JSON. Omitted/null/empty clears on manual replacement. Empty parts are null or an empty array.

DescriptionPart.description: Ordered content section in the parent text locale. All strings are plain text; never interpret as HTML.

ProductImage.description: Remote image reference only. Omitted/zero dimensions mean unknown. Caption is plain text.

DescriptionTrack.description: Advertised track, not a file binding. Duration retains seller wording/units.

ProductInfo.description: Optional product details, preserving provider units and semantics. Keys match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$, each JSON value <=256 KiB except localized_metadata <=4 MiB. Typical keys: series_name, price (JPY for DLsite), currency_price, age_category_string, duration (ASMR seconds), file_size, image_samples, language_editions, translation_info, rate_average_2dp, rate_count, dl_count. Client must render plain text and treat URLs/raw content as untrusted. Reserved normalized keys sample_images, age_rating and language_versions are validated across providers. series_name/series_id also normalize ASMR series. Missing age_rating means unknown, never all-ages by default. Manual protection/reset applies separately per product key.

summaries.description: Short provider summaries keyed by metadata BCP 47 locale; separate from the full description.

credit_references.description: Provider credit IDs and links; descriptive references, not local entity IDs.

original_product.description: Linked original product facts; does not replace current product identity or prose.

advertised_size.description: Seller-advertised size text; never a local media measurement.

advertised_duration.description: Upstream-advertised duration value with unit marker; not locally probed.

field_sources.description: Field paths supplemented from the secondary provider.

price.description: Validated provider observation; missing/null is unknown, explicit zero is retained.

official_price.description: Validated provider observation; missing/null is unknown, explicit zero is retained.

price_without_tax.description: Validated provider observation; missing/null is unknown, explicit zero is retained.

discount_rate.description: Validated provider observation; missing/null is unknown, explicit zero is retained.

rate_average_2dp.description: Validated provider observation; missing/null is unknown, explicit zero is retained.

rate_count.description: Validated provider observation; missing/null is unknown, explicit zero is retained.

dl_count.description: Validated provider observation; missing/null is unknown, explicit zero is retained.

review_count.description: Validated provider observation; missing/null is unknown, explicit zero is retained.

wishlist_count.description: Validated provider observation; missing/null is unknown, explicit zero is retained.

is_discount.description: Explicit provider flag; false is retained. Does not establish permanent free availability.

is_sale.description: Explicit provider flag; false is retained. Does not establish permanent free availability.

is_free.description: Explicit provider flag; false is retained. Does not establish permanent free availability.

currency.description: Price currency; current providers return JPY.

rate_count_detail.description: Validated per-star counts: an object keyed by stars 1..5, or an array of review_point/count records. Provider numeric strings may be retained in the distribution.

localized_metadata.description: Canonical metadata language tags to complete language records, total JSON size <=4 MiB. Request switches support zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja and en.

ProductEdition.description: Published edition reference, not a local work merge or audio-language assertion.

raw.description: Original upstream JSON evidence, at most 12 MiB. Not replaced by local translations.

url.description: Must be a supported provider image URL referenced by package metadata or translations.

data.description: Base64 original JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP bytes; maximum 16 MiB decoded per image, 32 MiB decoded total per package.

login_ip.description: Connection peer IP at login. Forwarded headers are not trusted.

language.description: Selected requested metadata observation locale; actual text locales remain in values.metadata.texts. Empty for language-independent fields.

metadata_locales.description: 自动获取时逐一尝试的资料语言。

default_return_locale.description: 查询未指定语言时优先返回的资料语言。

diagnostics_enabled.description: Server-wide detailed diagnostics. Persists across restart and applies after a successful settings save.

metadata_locales.description: 自动获取时逐一尝试的资料语言。

default_return_locale.description: 查询未指定语言时优先返回的资料语言。

diagnostics_enabled.description: Server-wide detailed diagnostics. Persists across restart and applies after a successful settings save.

Job.description: Durable lookup or daily acquisition job. Source is a server-generated discovery snapshot, not a user-managed source.

LocalizedMetadata.description: Complete per-language display fields. Title and introduction are stored in texts with the same locale. Missing fields remain empty; clients must not fill them from another language. Source/raw is null; raw evidence is stored separately.

items.description: BCP 47 language tag; canonicalized by the server. Use und for unknown.

product_info.description: Only this language observation. Nested localized_metadata is rejected.

id.description: Decimal revision string. Preserve precision; do not convert through a floating-point number.

next_before.description: Decimal revision string. Preserve precision; do not convert through a floating-point number.
